integrity_notes: The infinite statements are proved symbolically from the published degree product and the standard Gamma-ratio asymptotic. Finite computation is used only for independent regression and identity replay.
scientific_limitations: The result gives a parity-wise exact curvature contraction and an asymptotic sign boundary. It does not settle the critical-scale second-order sign or prove full adjacent-in-corank monotonicity.
title: Parity-decaying curvature and a square-root-17 phase boundary for symmetric determinantal degrees
